a11y.intro: Your preferences are saved only in this browser and apply to all nine modules.
a11y.contraste_ayuda: Colors with more contrast between text and background.
a11y.movimiento_ayuda: Removes animations and transitions, in charts too.
a11y.espaciado_ayuda: Increases line height and the spacing between letters and words.
a11y.enlaces_ayuda: Links can be told apart without relying on color.
a11y.decal_ayuda: Adds patterns to the series so they can be told apart without color.
a11y.invertirX_ayuda: Turn it on if turning your head right moves the pointer left.
a11y.invertirY_ayuda: Turn it on if raising your head moves the pointer down.
a11y.camara_privacidad: The camera is processed only in your browser: no image is sent or stored. Only one mode is used at a time.
a11y.clic: How to click with your head
a11y.atajo_panel: Alt+Shift+A opens this center from any page.
a11y.atajo_esc: Esc stops the camera and closes dialogs.
a11y.ayuda_teclado: The whole site works with Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and the arrow keys; “Skip to content” is the first link on every page.
a11y.cam_consent_texto: To move the pointer with your head or your hand, the browser will analyze your camera image. The analysis happens only on your device: no image is sent or stored.
a11y.cam_consent_detener: You can stop it at any time with the Stop button or the Esc key.
a11y.cam_pausada: Paused: the pointer does not move.
a11y.cam_cara_no: I cannot see your face: sit in front of the camera with good light.
a11y.cam_mano_no: I cannot see your hand: raise it in front of the camera.
a11y.cam_error_permiso: The camera could not be used: permission was denied. The site still works with keyboard and mouse.
a11y.cam_error_sin_camara: No camera was found. The site still works with keyboard and mouse.
a11y.cam_error_general: Camera control could not start. The site still works with keyboard and mouse.
a11y.cam_anuncio_activa: Camera on. Press Esc to stop it.
a11y.cam_recentrado: Pointer recentered: your current head position is now the center of the screen.
a11y.cam_sin_cuadros: The camera is not sending images; retrying…
a11y.cam_puno_pausar: Keep your fist closed to pause…
a11y.cam_puno_reanudar: Keep your fist closed to resume…
a11y.rango_ayuda: Degrees you need to turn your head to reach the edge of the screen. Fewer degrees: the pointer moves faster.

clasificacion.titulo_pagina: Binary trend classification · Ernesto Investing AI
clasificacion.sub: Will each asset go up or down? There are only two classes: UP or DOWN.
clasificacion.ficha_que_hace: Uses {n} models ({ml} Machine Learning and {dl} Deep Learning) to estimate whether each asset's price {h} sessions from now will be higher than today's. There are only two answers: UP or DOWN.
clasificacion.ficha_que_tan_bien: Accuracy from {exmin} to {exmax} and AUC from {aucmin} to {aucmax} on a {n}-day test. That is barely better than a coin flip: a model that always said UP would score {base}.
clasificacion.ficha_por_que: Each cell is the probability of UP that one model gives for one asset. The consensus is the average of the {n} models, and confidence tells how far that average is from {mitad}.
clasificacion.ficha_controlas: The asset group, the model family, which models are shown and whether you see only your watchlist.
clasificacion.ficha_ignorar: You can hide any model you do not trust. None of this is an order to buy or sell.
clasificacion.sin_modelos: No model is visible. Tick one under “Visible models” or change the family.
clasificacion.sin_filas: No asset matches the filters. Change the group or untick “My watchlist only”.
clasificacion.mapa_titulo: Heatmap: probability of UP by asset and model
clasificacion.mapa_ayuda: Each cell says UP or DOWN with its symbol and the probability of UP. Pick an asset to see its consensus.
clasificacion.mapa_caption: Probability of UP from each model for each asset; every cell says UP or DOWN with a symbol.
clasificacion.votos_aria: Votes: {sube} for UP and {baja} for DOWN
clasificacion.consenso_explica: Votes from the {n} models: {sube} for UP and {baja} for DOWN. The mean probability of going up is {prob}. The consensus is {senal}, with {confianza} confidence.
clasificacion.confianza_explica: Confidence measures how far the mean probability is from {mitad}: it is high from {alta} points away and medium from {media}.
clasificacion.consenso_recuerda: Remember: on the test these models were right between {min} and {max} of the time. It is a weak hint, not a certainty.
clasificacion.metricas_ayuda: Pick a model to see its confusion matrix. The column headers sort the table.
clasificacion.metricas_caption: Metrics for each model on a {n}-day test
clasificacion.mc_caption: Confusion matrix for {modelo}: what the model said versus what happened
clasificacion.mc_frase: Of the {dijo} days it said UP, it was right {vp} times; of the {dijo_baja} days it said DOWN, it was right {vn} times. The test covers {n} days.
clasificacion.honestidad_p1: If you flip a coin {cien} times to guess whether a price goes up or down, you are right about {mitad} times. These {n} models were right between {min} and {max} out of every {cien} on the test: only slightly better than the coin. They are a weak hint, not a certainty.
clasificacion.honestidad_p2: Also, a model that always said UP would have been right {base}, because over those {dias} test days the price went up that share of the time. That is why every signal comes with the consensus, the confidence and the metrics.
